production_impact: read-only contract audit; no provider selection, pose write, Stack_Report, QG, or default change

rust_contract.descriptor_requirement: one validated Descriptor row per keypoint; binary/uint8/float32 byte length must match dimension
rust_contract.match_requirement: sorted source/target indices with finite distance and confidence in [0,1]
rust_contract.geometry_authority: Rust validates provider payload then runs geometry gate; sidecar cannot inject homography

decision.conclusion: Direct ONNX Runtime inspection confirms the model has exactly keypoints, matches and mscores outputs; there is no hidden descriptor output for the script to recover. The learned candidate cannot be adapted by relabeling keypoints/matches.
decision.next_step: either add a descriptor-emitting learned sidecar plus explicit coordinate-frame contract, or defer PF.10; do not write a production adapter that fabricates descriptors

limitations: no provider payload was submitted to Rust geometry gate
no new source material or full artwork run
